title: One-Shot Takeoff
summary: Draw a box around one symbol on a construction drawing and find every other instance of it. Doors, detail markers, elevation markers, and receptacles, taken off a rasterized sheet rather than its vector geometry. FFT cross-correlation is implemented end to end; five other strategies are designed to plug in behind the same function.

title: Job Board Tracker
summary: Tracks applications across job boards and company portals in a local SQLite database. Run as a service on a home server, it watches the inbox, files acknowledgements and interview requests under the right application, and turns job-alert emails into a to-apply list with a tailored resume already drafted.

title: SignLink
summary: The recognition side started at HooHacks 2024: MediaPipe hand landmarks matched against reference signs with dynamic time warping. The wearable version, with the model running on embedded hardware, is the long tail.

title: MNIST from the ground up
summary: Handwritten digit recognition on MNIST, the first machine learning thing I ever built, in both PyTorch and TensorFlow.

title: Water 4 Chad
summary: An AR simulation of a river in Chad where engineers place water-cleaning dams and watch the effect on the flow, set up in the real environment through a headset.

title: Hokie Feast
summary: Generates recipes from whatever is actually in a college student's fridge.

title: Safewalk
summary: A crime-report database for each Northern Virginia Community College campus, so students can pick class times with the fewest expected incidents, with AI-written safety recommendations.

title: Street Fighter
summary: A fitness game that lets you box against an AI opponent. MediaPipe tracks your body and scores your form in real time.

title: Musical Stocks
summary: Turns live market data into music so a day trader can hear the market instead of watching it.

title: ROI Bot
summary: A real-estate investment guide that forecasts a property's value over time.

title: Systems programming in C
summary: Four builds that cover the three things that break at scale: a custom shell with process control and I/O redirection, a threadpool with worker scheduling and synchronization, a custom memory allocator, and an HTTP server with MP4 streaming, cookies, and a token-authenticated API.

title: Mixed reality builds
summary: Four Unity projects for a mixed reality course: a VR night island with locomotion, a VR escape room built around interaction techniques, and room-scale AR basketball and golf with physics grounded in the real room.

title: MoodMuse
summary: A multimodal journaling app that reads the mood of an entry and builds a Spotify playlist to match.
